That is the headline, but it does not describe engagement across the whole company. The survey was sent to head-office staff only; the three regional offices and the warehouse sites, which together employ 60% of all staff, were not included. The 7.8 figure therefore reflects the head-office population and cannot be generalised to the wider workforce. The 68% response rate among those who were reached is a further, smaller caveat.

In short, the pulse is a useful read on head-office sentiment, but it is silent on the majority of the company's people, so any "company-wide" interpretation would overstate what the data actually covers.
